scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && rm -rf ../backend/public && mkdir -p ../backend/public && cp -R build/* ../backend/public/
